en: The postcard shows a color photograph of a historic Ottoman-era mosque with a stone dome and a tall slender minaret rising behind it. The mosque is partly obscured by trees and an old stone wall in the foreground, with adjacent multi‑storey buildings framing the scene under a clear blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual printed captions identifying the mosque, standard postcard address lines, stamp boxes, and publisher information in Hungarian.
